Specification: This module validates execution traces of a CCF Raft implementation against a Raft TLA+ model by reading a JSON trace log, filtering raft-related events, and constraining the model to follow those events step by step. It defines predicates that match concrete log lines to specific protocol actions such as timeouts, elections, append-entries exchange, configuration changes, and request-vote handling, while also accounting for implementation details such as piggybacked UpdateTerm behavior and possible message loss. The specification checks that the trace can be matched by the model, that the resulting states satisfy the underlying ccfraft invariants as state constraints, and includes temporal properties ensuring successful trace traversal and a reference specification for composed next-state behavior.
IfThenElse: IF logline.msg.packet.msg = "raft_request_vote" THEN msg.isPreVote = FALSE ELSE msg.isPreVote = TRUE
IF "CCF_RAFT_TRACE" \in DOMAIN IOEnv THEN IOEnv.CCF_RAFT_TRACE ELSE "../traces/consensus/append.ndjson"

CASE msg.type = AppendEntriesResponse -> IsAppendEntriesResponse(msg, dst, src, logline)
      [] msg.type = AppendEntriesRequest  -> IsAppendEntriesRequest(msg, dst, src, logline)
      [] msg.type = RequestVoteRequest    -> IsRequestVoteRequest(msg, dst, src, logline)
      [] msg.type = RequestVoteResponse   -> IsRequestVoteResponse(msg, dst, src, logline)
      [] msg.type = ProposeVoteRequest    -> IsProposeVoteRequest(msg, dst, src, logline)
